queries.query:
import "strings"
import "date"
import "experimental"
sensorEvents = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: dashboardTime, stop: upperDashboardTime)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTAOS.logevent_wavefrontError" and 
      r._field == "sensorId" and 
      r._value == 8
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)  // Limit to the last instance

coeffs = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: dashboardTime, stop: upperDashboardTime)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTAOS.logevent_wavefrontError" and 
      (r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff0" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff1" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff2" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff3" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff4" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff5" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff6" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff7" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff8" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff9" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff10" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff11" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff12" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff13" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff14" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff15" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff16" or
	   r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff17" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff18" or
       r._field == "annularZernikeCoeff19")
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  
join(
    tables: {sensorEvents: sensorEvents, coeffs: coeffs},
    on: ["_time"]
)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      // Parse the index from the field name and convert to int
      index = int(v: strings.replaceAll(v: r._field, t: "annularZernikeCoeff", u: "")) + 4
      time_delay = duration(v: strings.replaceAll(v: r._field, t: "annularZernikeCoeff", u: "") + "s")
      
      // Generate synthetic time by adding seconds based on index
      // synthetic_time = date.add(d: r._time, to: duration(v: index)) // 1s interval
      //time_string = date.add(d: time(v: 2019-07-17T12:05:21.012934584Z), to: 1s)
      zernike_name = "zernike_" + string(v: r.index)


      return {
          zernike_coeff: r._value,
          _time: experimental.addDuration(d: time_delay, to: 2019-07-17T04:00:04.0Z)
      }
  })
  |> sort(columns: ["index"]) 
  |> yield(name: "zernikeCoefficientsOverTime")
